**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Document the new unreachable-Herdr behavior**

When `herdr status server --json` fails or yields malformed/unknown JSON, this branch now lets `make update` succeed and skips reload, but `README.md:177-180` still says ambiguous status fails the target. That leaves the documented lifecycle contract wrong precisely when the server is unreachable; update it to describe the warning-and-skip behavior.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Document the pending AppArmor-profile path**

On restricted Ubuntu hosts with no cached sudo credentials, this now exits successfully without loading the profile. `README.md:295-300` still says `chezmoi apply` installs the profile and `make doctor` confirms it works, so users can reasonably expect sandboxing to be available after `make update`; document the pending state and the required manual remedy.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
